about: The client's savegame manager (ecl::SavegameManager). Its byte +0xf8 is IsLoading and +0xf9 IsSaving (macOS +0xc8/+0xc9, Toolkit +0x100/+0x101): code:ecl::GameStateStartLoading::CanExit holds StartLoading while +0xf9 is set, so a save in progress is the only thing besides the load state that can hold the startup stage; nothing in the state machine ends it on a timer.

evidence.says: dx11 StartLoading::CanExit (code:ecl::GameStateStartLoading::CanExit) reads *(code:ecl::SavegameManager::m_ptr)+0xf9 where macOS ecl::GameStateStartLoading::CanExit reads SavegameManager::m_ptr+0xc9; Toolkit ecl::SavegameManager::IsSaving returns this[0x101], IsLoading this[0x100]; dx11 bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x42530C0 sets +0xf9=1 before sending the save message 0x9f; dx11 bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x5889E0 and bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x139A160 test +0xf8 and +0xf9 together

live dx11 copy attacks, main menu: the pointer at code:ecl::SavegameManager::m_ptr leads to an object whose first field is the virtual table bg3_dx11.exe@25605617+0x55F30F8, which the database names ecl::SavegameManager's (slots ecl::SavegameManager::GetInputListenerName and OnInputEvent); its +0xF8 and +0xF9 read 0 and 0 there (nothing loading or saving)
